## About
Tim's Transmission Service is a family-owned, second-generation shop on Universal Rd, serving the Pittsburgh area. Tim McIntyre Jr. is the owner, and the work here is transmissions: manual and automatic, for fleet vehicles and passenger cars alike.
We rebuild and repair transmissions and transfer cases, install used or re-manufactured transmissions, replace clutches, change fluid and filters, and handle computer and software updates on most makes and models. We are members of ATSG and TRNW.
One reviewer wrote that Tim and his team take the time to explain what's going on with your vehicle without any pressure. That's how we like to do it. Call us or stop by Monday through Friday.

## Services
- Automatic transmission rebuilds and repair: Rebuilds and repairs for automatic transmissions.
- Manual transmission rebuilds and repair: Rebuilds and repairs for manual transmissions.
- Transfer case rebuilds and repair: Rebuilds and repairs for transfer cases.
- Installation of transmissions and transfer cases: We install transmissions and transfer cases.
- Clutch replacement: If your clutch is giving you trouble, bring the vehicle in and we'll fix the issue.
- Transmission fluid and filter changes: Routine fluid and filter service for your transmission.
- Computer and software updates: Transmission computer and software updates on most makes and models.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on manual and automatic transmissions?
A: Yes. We handle both manual and automatic transmission services.

Q: Do you service fleet vehicles?
A: Yes. We do transmission work for both fleet and passenger vehicles.

Q: How soon can I get in?
A: Appointments are available for next-day service. Give us a call or request service online.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
